instruction: How much have I paid in prime membership since I made the amazon account?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only has lookup actions. 'Since I made the account' simply means all prime subscriptions in the history, so the answer is the sum of the amount field over every entry returned by amazon.show_prime_subscriptions (a larger page_limit / extra page_index calls may be needed, which explains the 5-call reference solution). The computed total is represented by the runtime amount object prime-total-amount, which is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, the mandatory last action.
